newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 790 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 790 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 790 contracts compared with 2,654 overnight Sunday, according to the CBOT.
There were 76 wheat, 252 corn, 356 soybean, 61 soymeal, four oat, 21 soyoil, four corn calls, two corn puts, eight soybean calls and six soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 3/4 to 1-1/2 cents higher, corn was steady to 1/2 cent higher and soybeans were 2-1/2 cents lower to 2-1/2 cents higher.
